rentals:10:1139129.overview: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.
rentals:10:1139129.title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders

rentals:10:1226230.overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.
rentals:10:1226230.title: Bunker Heights

rentals:10:1282159.overview: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.
rentals:10:1282159.title: Let's Have Kids!

rentals:10:1701085.overview: In Comfort, Kentucky, Ginny Nolan tries to keep her family's Christmas shop afloat as coffee-chain owner Nick Day offers to buy it. Meanwhile, Ginny's ex-flame and former songwriting partner Tyler Benton returns to town, seeking her help.
rentals:10:1701085.title: Silver Bells at Christmas

rentals:10:1767251.overview: Myrna, a former gang member, runs a roadside motel with her younger boyfriend, Floyd. When her old gang arrives for a mysterious Bitcoin heist, buried grudges, jealousy, and betrayal threaten the score- and the new life Myrna fought to build.
rentals:10:1767251.title: Blood Before Bitcoin

rentals:10:1790001.overview: Five friends from Chicago head into the woods for a weekend getaway with their coworkers. What begins as a chance to escape the everyday quickly turns terrifying when the group discovers that the legend surrounding their destination is far from a campfire story.
rentals:10:1790001.title: Camp Night

rentals:10:1794750.overview: Over the past six years, a team of filmmakers has been following more than a dozen Americans in eight states across the U.S., charting their views about changes in the country and in their own lives. Now, a month before the midterm elections, how are these Americans — from a doctor to a pastor to a barber to a construction company owner to a retiree — feeling about the direction of the country? "American Voices 2026" asks how their hopes and fears have evolved amid another polarizing election season, a faltering economy, and a war with Iran that's now in its eighth month.
rentals:10:1794750.title: American Voices 2026

svod:15:1776531.overview: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.
svod:15:1776531.title: Clown Panic

svod:15:1787736.overview: Everyone’s stressed. We’re all hanging on BY A THREAD. But don’t worry, we can all laugh about it together. BY A THREAD. October 16. Hulu.
svod:15:1787736.title: Heather McMahan: By a Thread

svod:1899:1771844.overview: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate Berlant offers up reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.
svod:1899:1771844.title: Kate Berlant: Parmesan

svod:8:1512493.overview: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.
svod:8:1512493.title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical

svod:8:1620918.overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.
svod:8:1620918.title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald

svod:8:1623256.overview: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.
svod:8:1623256.title: The Storm

svod:8:1773759.overview: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.
svod:8:1773759.title: Seriously Single Too

svod:8:1788682.overview: Singlehood, relationships with parents and facing taboos — Sumukhi Suresh doesn't hold back as she tackles all this and more in her comedy special.
svod:8:1788682.title: Sumukhi Suresh: Hoemonal

svod:9:1561726.overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.
svod:9:1561726.title: Masterplan
